entities.name: Robert Douglas, Count of Skenninge
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Douglas, Count of Skenninge, Baron of Skalby, was a Scottish cavalry general during the Thirty Years' War who rose to the rank of field marshal (1657–1662) in the Swedish-Polish wars that followed. He founded the Swedish branch of Clan Douglas.
